title: SR Flip-Flop
description: Implement clocked SR flip-flop (positive edge triggered).
template:
module sr_ff(input clk, s, r, output reg q);
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    case({s,r})
      2'b10: q <= 1'b1;  // Set
      2'b01: q <= 1'b0;  // Reset
      2'b11: q <= 1'bx;  // Invalid
      // 2'b00: q <= q;   // Hold (implicit)
    endcase
  end
endmodule
hint: Use case statement for SR combination on clock edge

title: JK Flip-Flop
description: Implement clocked JK flip-flop (positive edge triggered).
template:
module jk_ff(input clk, j, k, output reg q);
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    case({j,k})
      2'b00: q <= q;     // Hold
      2'b01: q <= 1'b0;  // Reset
      2'b10: q <= 1'b1;  // Set
      2'b11: q <= ~q;    // Toggle
    endcase
  end
endmodule
hint: JK eliminates invalid state of SR: J=K=1 toggles
